page.overview:
What is Gift with Purchase?

Gift with Purchase, or GWP for short, sets are free sets given to people who spend a certain amount of money on LEGO products. They are usually limited time and exclusive to people who purchase sets at participating LEGO stores or in LEGO.com. LEGO and Toys-R-US launched Bricktober in 2009, a month-long celebration on October that usually offered various Gift with Purchase sets to customers.

These sets were exclusively given through the purchase of LEGO products in LEGO stores, LEGO.com or other retailers.

These sets are not exclusive to LEGO.com or any retailers through the purchase of LEGO products.

This sets were given out for free as Bricktober sets
